scientific_integrity: Proof and exact-rational finite computational crosschecks are supplied; mathematical claims remain subject to independent expert audit.
scientific_limitations: Unit positive symmetric cross-part valuations and zero within-part valuations only.
Greedy algorithm resolves every equal strictly positive welfare gain toward the earliest-created coalition; arbitrary tie-breaking may invalidate the formula.
Uniform random vertex arrival is essential; no assertion for adversarial or nonuniform arrival.
Finite verifier checks do not independently certify the all-size proof.
A bounded literature search cannot establish exhaustive publication priority.
title: Exact random-order greedy welfare on biclique coalition networks
